title: kbingest map keeps PATH entries under the source repository's own clone
goal: scrub_env also drops every PATH entry under the source repository REPO given to kbingest map (its clone, not only the scratch worktree), so an operator PATH naming <clone>/node_modules/.bin or a direnv-added repository bin folder cannot make a mapper child run a repository program; a test named kbingest_map_path_outside_source_clone with a planted entry proves it (found while fixing BG-2g3zo4g7)
